Мелкой считается деталь с малой площадью: A small part is one with a small area or a narrow strip — the vacuum holds them poorly. If checked, all small parts of the sheet are cut first, and only then the large ones. Among small parts, those farther from large parts go first, those adjacent to a large part go last: at the moment of cutting the small part still holds on to its untouched neighbour. The last segment cut on a small part is the one separating it from a not-yet-cut neighbour (the larger, the better). Large parts are cut along the shortest route: of two neighbours, the noticeably smaller one goes first; the largest part of the sheet goes last. On any part, small or large, the last segment cut is the one along which no neighbours have been cut yet — it separates the part from the largest untouched piece (part or offcut), and the feed is reduced on it.
